none: PAS IOW-E71523: Lead weight with moulded legend in Roman numerals: IV
contea di ritrovamento: Isle of Wight (Inghilterra e Galles)

Sub-circular lead weight of possible Post-medieval date. Diameter 31mm and 7.5mm thick. Weight 48.26g. The sides of the weight are bevelled (sloping inwards from the bottom) and there is a slightly raised rim on the top surface. The underside is plain. However, two iregular shaped holes near the centre may be casting flaws. The weight has a moulded legend on the top in Roman numerals "IV"
